title: SwingVision Match Quality Goal Adherence by Surface
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:session
| stats avg(shot_quality_score) as actual count as sessions by surface
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/75.0,1), goal_label="75"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average shot quality score with a simple target for each surface, showing where swingvision match quality is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by surface shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence surface values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of surface values with average shot quality score and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which surface settings help you hit your target for swingvision match quality and which ones fall short.
